g.text: Digital Audio Clocking Roles & Frame Synchronization
Clock Provider vs Consumer architectures, Philips I2S bit-alignment, TDM multi-slot framing, and PDM dual-edge multiplexing
Clock Provider Mode (Target DUT Drives BCLK & WS)
• Resets slot counter on WS edge
Clock Consumer Mode (Audio Bridge Drives BCLK & WS)
Philips I2S Timing Diagram (Stereo 32-bit / 64 BCLKs per Audio Frame)
Zero Pad / Unused (16 or 24-bit audio in 32-bit slot)
Standard 1 BCLK delay between WS transition and MSB transmission (Philips standard)
Data Latched on BCLK Rising Edge | Driven on BCLK Falling Edge
Multi-Channel TDM & PDM Sigma-Delta Modulation Framing
8-Channel TDM Bus Framing (256 BCLK cycles / Frame)
FSYNC Pulse = 1 BCLK cycle wide at start of Slot 0 | 32 bits per time slot = 24.576 MHz @ 96 kHz
PDM Dual-Microphone Multiplexing (Single Clock & Data Line)
MIC 0 (Left): Sampled on CLK Rising Edge ↑
MIC 1 (Right): Sampled on CLK Falling Edge ↓
Oversampling Ratio (OSR): 64x or 128x | Clock: 3.072 MHz (48 kHz) or 1.024 MHz (16 kHz WOV)
